surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during ALD-ZnO deposition involve the self-limiting chemical surface reactions that constitute ALD, with the choice of precursors (DEZ vs. DMZ), process steps (dose and purge times), and post-processing affecting the film properties. The standard process uses DEZ and water as precursors, with the surface reactions likely involving the adsorption and reaction of these precursors on the substrate.
evidence: Due to the self-limiting chemical surface reactions that constitute ALD, there are three possible ways to manipulate the ﬁlm properties: 1) the choice of precursors 2) the ALD process steps themselves (i.e., dose and purge times) 3) post-processing of the ﬁlm.
